**#829 — the anti-loop lock reads verdict CONTROLS, not existence**

Fixed in worktree brain-issue-829, commit c1f393b. wouldRepeatLastVerdict (poster.mjs) gains one arm: a last verdict of mine at this head whose controls_not_applied includes 'inferential' does NOT lock against a run that would apply that half — there is no reasoned output at that head, read or unread (measured on PR #828: two half-runs, and the only path to a full verdict was a docs commit defeating the lock). Loop safety preserved on every other arm: full verdict locks, half-vs-would-be-half locks, legacy verdict without the controls line locks (absence is not evidence). CLI decides 'would this run apply the half' BEFORE the spawn (judgment.run + injected generator or routed sdd.map; malformed entry counts as would-apply so the stage's wrapped throw reports the operator's typo). postVerdict receives nextAppliesInferential as BUILT (controls.includes('inferential')), never re-derived. RED at two levels + 3 preservation pins + mutation check (disabling the arm reds exactly the two #829 tests). Suite 4648/0.
